Subject: Quick question on invoice submission for legacy invoices

Hi Jasmine —

Thanks for the onboarding window last week. A follow-up from our AP team: we have a small back-file of legacy invoices that are single-PDF exports (line items embedded in the PDF) and several one-off credit memos. Our standard flow is portal upload, but the portal validation rejects the old PDFs (no structured line items).

Two asks:
1) Is there a documented exception path to submit via email for legacy PDFs?
2) If we must email, what fields do you need in the subject/body to ensure PO stamping and correct entity mapping?

Attaching a sample BP_INV_7843.pdf and a CSV example of our export. If easier we can bulk SFTP but that requires a slightly longer lead time.

Thanks —
Ananya
Billing Ops | BluePeak
(attachment: BP_INV_7843.pdf)
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Ananya Rao <ananya@bluepeak.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 May 2028 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick question on invoice submission for legacy invoices

Hi Ananya —

Appreciate the sample. Short answer: yes, we can accept an email exception for legacy PDFs for an initial short-period migration, but we need an explicit minimal handshake in the email to ensure automated PO stamping and ledger routing. Our recommended policy:

- Submit to billing@redwood.com with subject line prefix: [Invoice Submission - EXCEPTION] followed by your PO (if available) or the internal BluePeak invoice number. Example: "[Invoice Submission - EXCEPTION] PO: 12345 / BP_INV_7843".
- Body should include these fields (one-line, bullet or CSV is fine): Vendor legal name; Redwood PO number (or \"PO-less\"); Bill-to entity (if multiple); Invoice date; Invoice total; Currency; Contact for follow-up.
- Attach the original PDF. If you have the CSV, attach that as well; we will use it to seed the line-item mapping table.

Operational notes:
- Jordan will review the mapping and create a one-off ingestion rule. If there are < 50 invoices in the back-file and totals match, we can approve the email exception window for up to 30 days. For anything larger we'll ask you to SFTP or use the portal with a pre-processing pass.
- For PO stamping: if the email subject contains a valid Redwood PO, our ingestion automations will stamp before routing. If PO is missing, we will mark as \"PO-less\" and route to AP-review (slower).

Monica — can you pick up the mapping review when Ananya confirms? Jordan, flag if the 50-invoice threshold needs to be lower for any reason.

Best,
Jasmine
Senior Partnerships | Redwood Inference

- The attached CSV (bp_sample-mapping.csv) is our extract; line items are in a single text field (we included an exported line-item blob). Will that be usable or do you need a normalized row-per-line CSV?
- For the "Bill-to entity" field, our invoice includes a legacy subsidiary name. Is it ok if we put the Redwood legal entity in the email body (we don't have a standardized vendor code yet)?

I'll send the first 12 PDFs this afternoon with the subject prefix and the matching CSV.

Hi Ananya —

Quick technical reply from the mapping side: the exported blob is fine for a short exception window. Monica and I will extract line-items and backfill into our ingestion table. If you can include a simple one-line delimiter for each line (e.g., \"||\" between lines) in the CSV field, that speeds parsing and reduces manual work.

On the subsidiary name: yes — please include the Redwood legal entity in the body. Example body snippet we need for each email: 

Vendor: BluePeak
Redwood entity: Redwood Inference, Inc.
PO: PO-12345 (or PO-less)
Invoice date: 2028-04-28
Invoice total: $4,320.00
Redwood contact: Jasmine Liu - jasmine.liu@redwood.ai

We'll handle stamping and post-processing once we receive the batch. If anything is failing on our side, I'll escalate to the AP inbox.

Jordan
Billing Integrations | Redwood Inference
